description: This file defines a Flutter widget called LetterTile, which represents a single tile in a word-guessing game. The tile visually indicates its state (correct, present, absent, filled, empty) with different colors, and includes an animated flip effect when its state updates.

classes.name: LetterTile
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a letter with visual and animated state changes.

classes.name: _LetterTileState
classes.description: The private state class for LetterTile managing animation and rendering.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the animation controller and flip animation.

methods.name: didUpdateWidget
methods.description: Triggers the flip animation when the tile's state changes to a non-empty, non-filled state.

methods.name: _backgroundFor
methods.description: Returns background color based on tile state.

methods.name: _borderFor
methods.description: Returns border color based on tile state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the animated flipping tile widget.
